script_context.title: Neon Nights
script_context.logline: A cab-driving ex-detective chases a deepfake blackmail ring through the city's neon underbelly.

scenes.heading: EXT. NEON DISTRICT STREET - NIGHT
scenes.title: Rain on the neon strip
scenes.summary: Mara Voss works her cab shift through the rain as the city's neon hums overhead.

scenes.heading: INT. MARA'S CAB - NIGHT
scenes.title: The passenger's confession
scenes.summary: A nervous passenger tells Mara Voss about a blackmail video that never happened.

scenes.heading: INT. NIGHTCLUB - NIGHT
scenes.title: First look at Silas
scenes.summary: Mara Voss tracks the ring to a packed club and sees Silas Kade holding court.

scenes.heading: INT. ROOFTOP BAR - NIGHT
scenes.title: The rooftop toast
scenes.summary: Silas Kade raises a glass to the new clients and explains how the scheme works.

scenes.heading: INT. HARBOR WAREHOUSE - NIGHT
scenes.title: Showdown at the warehouse
scenes.summary: Mara Voss confronts Silas Kade among the servers that run the deepfakes.

scenes.heading: EXT. HARBOR DOCKS - DAWN
scenes.title: Dawn at the harbor
scenes.summary: The rain stops and Mara Voss watches the sun come up over the water.
